rationale: C15 is a highly plausible direct drafting precursor. It concerns the same newly enacted Federal Property and Administrative Services Act, addresses the same Administrator of General Services, and uses the same study-to-standards administrative mechanism later expanded in the child. The child generalizes C15's procurement-focused instructions into a government-wide implementation program involving studies, surveys, consultation, regulations, standards, manuals, reports, and inventory controls. C23 and C03 contain weaker structural parallels involving interagency consultation and delegated administrative procedures, but neither shares the child's specific statutory setting or sufficiently distinctive machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Administrator of General Services shall institute studies and surveys... When these studies and surveys have been completed and after consulting with the interested agencies, the Administrator shall prescribe such regulations as may be necessary
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am therefore asking you to undertake a study looking toward the issuance of detailed standards to guide procurement officers in carrying out the intent of this law
shared_material.explanation: Both direct the same Administrator, under the same new Act, to conduct a study and then issue operational standards or regulations implementing the statute.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the Administrator of General Services shall establish such standards, prescribe such regulations, and prepare and issue such manuals and procedures as may be necessary to guide all Executive agencies
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the issuance of detailed standards to guide procurement officers... In order to make this policy uniform in the Federal Government
shared_material.explanation: The child materially expands the parent's standards-guidance-uniformity mechanism from procurement officers to all executive agencies and broader property and records management.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Each Executive agency shall carefully plan and schedule its requirements for supplies, equipment, materials and all other personal property
shared_material.parent_excerpt: A better system of property and records management has been needed... to achieve effective and economical results in the property management field
shared_material.explanation: The child's operative property-management requirements implement the same efficiency and economy objective articulated in C15.
